intro: The Emerald Dreamcatcher is a sacred night elf amulet crafted to draw subtle vigor from the Emerald Dream. Bestowed upon Tallonkai Swiftroot by the druids of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, it was left behind in Starbreeze Village when the Gnarlpine furbolgs succumbed to corruption and overran the settlement.

p: Crafted under the auspices of Gaerolas Talvethren, the druidic warden of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Emerald Dreamcatcher is an enchanted relic given to only a chosen few. It is designed to siphon ambient energies directly from the Emerald Dream, blessing whoever carries it with fortune and protection. When Starbreeze Village fell to the maddened Gnarlpine furbolg, the amulet was left behind inside a dresser, stranded in the middle of hostile, corrupted territory.
